name: notmyfault
description: Tells you whether a failing test is your fault or a known flaky test, in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Forgejo, Gitea and any CI system. No server, no runtime dependencies.
author: Aldwin Moutarlier

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --legal-comments=none --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --outfile=dist/notmyfault.mjs && esbuild src/dashboard-index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/dashboard.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
